facts.text: The IWORK work-study program covers remaining tuition, health insurance, housing, and meal costs for eligible students from Oceania and the Asian Rim who work 19 hours weekly.

sources.title: IWORK Work-Study Program - Financial Aid & Scholarships
sources.quote: A student participating in the IWORK Program works 19 hours (and up to 40 hours during breaks) a week at BYU–Hawaii or the Polynesian Cultural Center. A portion of this income goes back to the IWORK Program. An additional annual contribution, determined by individual financial assessment, is provided by the student and their family. The remaining cost of tuition, health insurance, housing, and meal plan is covered by BYU–Hawaii.
